title: 2x Cornflower 'Blue Boy' Plug Plants – RHS Plants for Pollinators!
description:
Brighten up your garden and support pollinators with these  2 healthy plug plants  of the classic  Cornflower 'Blue Boy'  (Centaurea cyanus).  
Key Features:      
RHS Plants for Pollinators  : Provides nectar and pollen for bees and other beneficial insects.    
Stunning Blooms  : Vivid blue, thistle-like flowers with dark purple centres, 3-4cm across.    
Height & Spread  : Grows up to 80cm tall, with a spread of 10-50cm.   
 Long Flowering  : Showy blooms all summer long.   
 Easy to Grow  : Thrives in poor, well-drained soils and full sun. Drought resistant and hardy (H6).   
 Perfect for  : Cottage gardens, wildflower meadows, wildlife gardens, cut flowers, and borders.
